packageRules.description: One pull request for the GitHub Actions in the workflows
The docs site's minor and patch updates together; majors on their own
LLVM: its archives' SHA-256s in scripts/get_llvm.* and the version the compiler reports change with it, so an update waits for approval on the dashboard
prBodyNotes:
**This pull request isn't complete as Renovate opens it.** Renovate changes only `VERSION=` in `scripts/get_llvm.sh` and `scripts/get_llvm.bat`. Before it can merge:

- [ ] Download both archives of the new release (`LLVM-{{{newVersion}}}-Linux-X64.tar.xz` and `clang+llvm-{{{newVersion}}}-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.xz`), and put their SHA-256s in `SHA256=` of each script.
- [ ] Update the LLVM cache keys: `llvm-{{{currentVersion}}}-linux` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/release.yml`, and `llvm-{{{currentVersion}}}-windows` in `release.yml`.
- [ ] Update what names the LLVM version: `git grep -n "{{{currentVersion}}}" -- . ":!deps" ":!docs/superpowers"` (CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, docs/rig-spec.md's `rig version` and debug producer strings, any test that pins them).
- [ ] Run `get_llvm`, build, and run `bin/unit-tests` and `bin/run-tests` (with `RIG_DEBUGGER_TESTS=required`) on Windows and Linux.
- [ ] Afterwards, run `get_llvm` again in each checkout, so its `deps/` holds the new release.
